title: 'susi workflow check --fix' applies the safe fixes
goal: Zero-config means zero REQUIRED files or env vars: derive, detect or default; where only the human can supply something (a secret, a consent) ask once at the moment of need, never via a hand-edited file. Merge origin/main, install hooks, create the worktree and switch into a prepared branch automatically; refuse when work would be lost. Integration test zc_workflow_fix.rs.
